findings.summary: __getstate__/__setstate__ now use dicts, so unpickling an old tuple-format pickle either raises TypeError or silently restores nothing; it should check isinstance(state, tuple) and use the old zip path.
No test loads an old tuple-format pickle, so the backward-compatibility bug would pass the suite.
Tests add a shared module-level class A and parametrize over a single class, which has no effect.
